title.en: Amdahl's law on a web server

concept.hr: Ubrzanje zahtjeva ograničavaju dijelovi koji nisu ubrzani
concept.en: A request's speedup is limited by the parts that are not sped up

summary.hr: Ubrzaj mrežu, bazu, logiku, disk ili predmemoriju jednog web zahtjeva i gledaj ukupno ubrzanje, usko grlo i granicu 1/s.
summary.en: Speed up the network, database, logic, disk or cache of one web request and watch the overall speedup, the bottleneck and the 1/s ceiling.
